etymologies.etymologyHTML: 1937, clipping of logogram or logotype.

definitions.definition: A visual symbol or emblem that acts as a trademark or a means of identification of a company or organization.

quote.citation: 2019, Li Huang, James Lambert, “Another Arrow for the Quiver: A New Methodology for Multilingual Researchers”, in Journal of Multilingual and Multicultural Development, →DOI, page 5:
quote.text: The unified colour palette of reds, blues, and yellows used throughout the signage matches that of the institution’s logo and letterhead.

definitions.definition: (by extension) An audio recording for the same purpose; a jingle.

quote.text: What about including a CD of your music or a copy of your audio logo/jingle in your promotional items  […]

definitions.definition: (sciences) A single graphic which contains one or more separate elements.
An ensign, a badge of office, rank, or power.
